facts.fact: 对上门做遗产估价的 Beresford 使出「鬼魂二难」：不信鬼就得信我活着。
facts.anchor: Yes, very much so – you see, I am John Grebble. And if you don’t believe in ghosts, then your only alternative is to believe that I’m alive.

facts.fact: 回家泡茶成了反抗仪式：能烧水、能挑杯子、能拿牛奶，就是活着的证据。
facts.anchor: The act of making tea felt, in a strange way, like an act of rebellion. That he was alive enough to boil water, to choose a mug, to take milk out of the fridge.

facts.fact: 他狠掐自己手腕：会疼， Toe 也疼——鬼魂不会脚趾痛。
facts.anchor: Then he stopped and pinched the skin of his left wrist, hard, with the fingers of his right hand. It hurt.

facts.fact: 他终于回 Jane 的短信：自己在公司成了「非人」，银行冻结账户，警方当他是骗子。
facts.anchor: I seem to be a non-person at Wilmot & Wilmot.

facts.fact: Jane 答应下班直接过来，两人第一次有了「他的家里有客人」的约定。
facts.anchor: I’ll come over straight after work. We can talk about this over a cuppa. No arguments.

facts.fact: Geoff 接电话开口就是威胁：和好免谈，埋斧头就埋在你脑袋里。
facts.anchor: I’m a very busy man, John, I don’t have time for small talk. If I was going to bury a hatchet, you know where I’d bury it – in your skull.

facts.fact: John 报出三年借款总额超四万镑，再开价两万现金「礼物」换 Geoff 作证。
facts.anchor: Because I do, Geoff. It’s over forty thousand. And now I’m prepared to give you another twenty thousand, which you don’t ever have to worry about paying back – it’s a gift.

facts.fact: 交易条款明确：两万镑换 Geoff 带护照去警局证明弟弟活着。
facts.anchor: OK, my proposition is that I pay you twenty thousand pounds – in cash – in return for which you accompany me to Brighton Police Station, with your passport, and you confirm that I am your brother – and that I am very much alive.

facts.fact: Jane 揭底：Geoff 因网上诈骗独居老太三万多镑坐过牢（Lewes 与 Ford 开放监狱）。
facts.anchor: He defrauded an elderly lady neighbour out of over thirty thousand pounds – online.

facts.fact: 352,000 镑存款已被转到迪拜 Al Noor Crescent 银行 Geoff 名下。
facts.anchor: That three hundred and fifty-two thousand pounds you had on deposit in the National Midland and Eastern Bank? It’s now on deposit in the Al Noor Crescent Bank in Dubai.

facts.fact: 死亡证明上的申报人（Informant）一栏写着 Geoffrey Anthony Grebble——亲弟弟签发的死亡。
facts.anchor: Beside Name of Informant was written Geoffrey Anthony Grebble.

facts.fact: Jane 解释 AI 时代系统对系统的多米诺：死亡登记一路自动 ping 遍 DVLA/NHS/HMRC/银行/薪资系统。
facts.anchor: One action triggers another and you get a domino effect. Registration of death, which is now increasingly becoming electronic – digital – and only needs very little human interaction, hits the GRO – the General Register Office.

facts.fact: 章末金句：John 借「复仇先挖两座坟」的谚语反问——其中一个已经是死人了。
facts.anchor: Do you need two graves if one of you is already dead?
